canonicalLearnerSource.english: Pawpaw and young citrus are sensitive to frost. Keep tender plants out of known low frost pockets. Observe local frost before planting.

currentLearnerDraft.tshivenda: Pawpaw na young citrus zwi a kwamea nga frost nga u leluwa. Ni songo vhea zwimela zwi sa konḓeleliho kha known low frost pockets. Sedzani frost ya henefho musi ni sa athu ṱavha.
